18364-my-war-experiences-in-two-continen.description: A book by S. Macnaughtan. On September 20th, 1914, I left London for Antwerp. At the station I found I had forgotten my passport and Mary had to tear back for it. Great perturbation, but kept this dark from the rest of the staff, for they are all rather serious and I am head of the orderlies. We got under way at 4 a.m.

arxiv-1802-05773.title: Experimental investigation of high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols with twisted photons
arxiv-1802-05773.creator: Frédéric Bouchard, Khabat Heshami, Duncan England, Robert Fickler, Robert W. Boyd, Berthold-Georg Englert, Luis L. Sánchez-Soto, Ebrahim Karimi
arxiv-1802-05773.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Quantum cryptography allows for the broadcasting of information between multiple parties in a perfectly secure manner under the sole assumption that the laws of quantum physics are valid [ 1 ] . Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) [ 2 , 3 ] is arguably the most well-known and studied quantum cryptographic protocol to date.

arxiv-2006-15441.title: Regularity of free boundary minimal surfaces in locally polyhedral domains
arxiv-2006-15441.creator: Nick Edelen and Chao Li
arxiv-2006-15441.description: Abstract . We prove an Allard-type regularity theorem for free-boundary minimal surfaces in Lipschitz domains locally modelled on convex polyhedra. We show that if such a minimal surface is sufficiently close to an appropriate free-boundary plane, then the surface is C 1 , α C^{1,\alpha} graphical over this plane.

arxiv-2107-04025.title: On the Expressive Power of Non-deterministic and Unambiguous Petri Nets over Infinite Words Volume: 183 Issue: 3-4
arxiv-2107-04025.creator: Olivier Finkel Institut de Mathématiques de Jussieu - Paris Rive Gauche CNRS, Université de Paris, Sorbonne Université, Paris, France. Olivier.Finkel@math.univ-paris-diderot.fr, Michał Skrzypczak Institute of Informatics University of Warsaw Banacha 2, 02-097 Warsaw, Poland mskrzypczak@mimuw.edu.pl
arxiv-2107-04025.description: Abstract We prove that ω \omega -languages of (non-deterministic) Petri nets and ω \omega -languages of (non-deterministic) Turing machines have the same topological complexity: the Borel and Wadge hierarchies of the class of ω \omega -languages of (non-deterministic) Petri nets are equal to the Borel and Wadge hierarchies of the class of ω \omega -languages of (non-deterministic) Turing machines.

arxiv-2301-01596.title: Hospital transfer risk prediction for COVID-19 patients from a medicalized hotel based on Diffusion GraphSAGE
arxiv-2301-01596.creator: Jun-En Ding, Chih-Ho Hsu, Kuan-Yin Lin, Ling Chen, Fang-Ming Hung
arxiv-2301-01596.description: Abstract The global COVID-19 pandemic has caused more than six million deaths worldwide. Medicalized hotels were established in Taiwan as quarantine facilities for COVID-19 patients with no or mild symptoms. Due to limited medical care available at these hotels, it is of paramount importance to identify patients at risk of clinical deterioration.

arxiv-2304-03555.title: A switching method for constructing cospectral gain graphs
arxiv-2304-03555.creator: Aida Abiad, Francesco Belardo, Antonina P. Khramova
arxiv-2304-03555.description: Abstract A gain graph over a group G G , also referred to as G G -gain graph, is a graph where an element of a group G G , called gain, is assigned to each oriented edge, in such a way that the inverse element is associated with the opposite orientation.

arxiv-2506-12764.title: Base3: a simple interpolation-based ensemble method for robust dynamic link prediction Conference: KDD; 2025; Toronto, ON
arxiv-2506-12764.creator: Emma Kondrup
arxiv-2506-12764.description: Abstract . Dynamic link prediction remains a central challenge in temporal graph learning, particularly in designing models that are both effective and practical for real-world deployment. Existing approaches often rely on complex neural architectures, which are computationally intensive and difficult to interpret.

arxiv-2506-13781.title: Solving the Job Shop Scheduling Problem with Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2506-13781.creator: Pablo Ariño Fernández
arxiv-2506-13781.description: Abstract A Customizable Reinforcement Learning Environment \degree B.Sc. \supervisor Prof. Carlos Quesada González \submityear 2025 \course Data Science and Artificial Intelligence \secondmarker \preamble Chapter 1 Introduction \thesisspacing This project addresses the JSSP ( JSSP ), one of the most classical and essential problems in scheduling.

arxiv-2602-05925.title: Adaptive Hashing
arxiv-2602-05925.creator: Gábor Melis
arxiv-2602-05925.description: Abstract Hash tables are ubiquitous, and the choice of hash function, which maps a key to a bucket, is key to their performance. We argue that the predominant approach of fixing the hash function for the lifetime of the hash table is suboptimal and propose adapting it to the current set of keys.

pmc-11346335.title: Early identification of the nosocomial spread of vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium by Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy and performance comparison with PFGE and WGS
pmc-11346335.creator: Cristina Pitart, Maria Piquet, Tessa Burgwinkel, Rocío Arazo Del Pino, Marc Rubio, Mireia Aguilar, Sergi De Gea, Andrea Pulgarín, Irene Campo, Blanca Torralbo, Romina Parejo, Silvia Valls, Isabel Fortes, Gemina Santana, Elisa Rubio, Anna Vilella, Ana Del Río, José Antonio Martínez, Elisenda Miró, Fe
pmc-11346335.description: Early detection of disseminating vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium (VREfm) in ICU wards is crucial for outbreak identification and the implementation of prompt infection control measures. Genotypic methods like pulsed-field gel electrophoresis (PFGE) and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) are costly and time-consuming, hindering rapid response due to batch dependency.

pmc-11975524.title: 以肠梗阻为首发症状的隐匿性乳腺癌1例
pmc-11975524.creator: 紫娟 王, 林 唐, 小辉 黄, 桃丽 王, 红月 连, 米多 谭
pmc-11975524.description: 隐匿性乳腺癌(occult breast cancer，OBC)是指体格检查、影像学检查及病理学检查均未能确认原发病灶的乳腺癌。本研究报告1例以肠梗阻为首发症状的OBC患者的临床资料。患者为67岁女性，无任何原发疾病而以肠梗阻为主要表现就诊于中南大学湘雅医学院附属株洲医院。腹部增强CT示直肠下段及升结肠增厚，肿瘤性病变可能。胸部CT示左侧腋窝多发淋巴结肿大。肠镜检查仅表现为黏膜充血、粗糙及肥厚。考虑肠道肿瘤性病变，行腹腔镜下直肠狭窄根治性切除术，术后病理诊断为直肠低分化腺癌，免疫组织化学染色结果显示雌激素受体(estrogen receptor，ER)、孕激素受体(progesterone receptor，PR)、GATA结合蛋白3(GATA binding protein 3，GATA3)、细胞角蛋白7(cytokeratin 7，CK7)表达均为阳性，考虑乳腺癌转移。乳腺MRI示双侧乳腺多发增生结节[乳腺影像报告与数据系统(breast imaging reporting and data system，BI-RADS)2]。右乳内下肿块、双侧腋窝及双侧锁骨上窝淋巴结活检结果：右乳乳腺组织未见明确癌；右侧腋窝淋巴结见小灶癌组织；左、右锁骨上窝及左腋窝淋巴结低分化癌，考虑乳腺来源。最终诊断为OBC伴淋巴结转移及直肠转移。术后16个月患者死亡。OBC通常难以找到乳腺原发病灶，OBC消化道转移尤其罕见，其临床表现往往被转移灶症状掩盖，容易被忽视，临床医生需重视；因病情进展迅速，易出现多器官损伤，预后极差，故应早期发现OBC原发病灶，以改善患者的预后。 隐匿性乳腺癌(occult breast cancer，OBC)是一种罕见特殊类型乳腺癌，发病率低、难以找到原发病灶，易漏诊、误诊。2022年中国乳腺癌的新发病例数为35.72万[1]，乳腺癌已成为女性健康首要危险因素。文献[2]报道OBC仅占所有乳腺癌的0.3%~1.0%，以腋窝淋巴结转移或转移到其他部位为首发症状，体格检查、影像学检查及病理学检查均无法发现原发病灶，诊断困难。OBC的消化道转移临床上罕见，目前报道较少，具体病因、机制及生物学行为尚不明确，容易被临床医师忽略。本文报告1例肠梗阻为首发症状的OBC的临床资料，初步探讨诊断、治疗方法，以期改善此类患者的预后。 病例资料 患者为67岁女性。因“排便困难3 d，伴腹痛5 h”于2022年5月28日就诊于中南大学湘雅医学院附属株洲医院(以下简称“我院”)。入院体格检查：腹肌无明显紧张，左下腹压痛，无反跳痛，墨菲征(-)，肝脾肋下触诊欠满意。肠鸣音较弱，约2 次/min。直肠指诊未触及明显肿块，肛门括约肌收缩可，指套退出无血染。大小便均正常，体重无明显变化。既往病史无特殊，否认家族遗传病及肿瘤史。腹部增强CT示直肠下段及升结肠增厚，肿瘤性病变可能 (图1A)。胸部CT示左侧腋窝多发淋巴结肿大 (图1B)。肠镜示距肛门约15 cm的直肠与乙状结肠交界处黏膜充血、肿胀、肥厚、粗糙，管腔变窄。病理结果示黏膜组织广泛水肿，有少许含铁血黄素，局灶充血。予抗感染、润肠通便等治疗后症状缓解，2022年6月11日应患者要求出院。 患者2022年5月的腹部CT增强扫描及胸部CT图像 Figure 1 Patient’s images of abdomen CT enhanced scan and chest CT in May 2022 A: Image of abdomen CT enhanced scan.

pmc-12438974.title: Pan-cancer analysis reveals intratumoral microbial diversity in multiple cancers by amplicon technology
pmc-12438974.creator: Xudong Liu, Yuteng Yao, Aoyi Xiao, Dingyan Cao, Jingheng Zhang, Yanan Shi, Qing Zhong, Zilong He, Wenming Wu
pmc-12438974.description: Despite numerous studies investigating intratumoral microorganisms and their significant roles in cancer initiation, progression, and treatment efficacy, a systematic understanding of intratumoral microorganisms remains lacking. Herein, we conducted a study using 16S rDNA data on seven types of cancer, comprising a total of 783 samples.

pmc-12678693.title: NUDIX hydrolases target specific inositol pyrophosphates and regulate phosphate homeostasis and bacterial pathogen susceptibility in Arabidopsis
pmc-12678693.creator: Robin Schneider, Klea Lami, Isabel Prucker, Sara Christina Stolze, Annett Strauß, Julie Marie Schmidt, Simon M Bartsch, Kevin Langenbach, Esther Lange, Kevin Ritter, David Furkert, Natalie Faiß, Sandeep Kumar, M Shamim Hasan, Athanasios Makris, Lukas Krusenbaum, Stefanie Wege, Yemisrach Zewdu Belay,
pmc-12678693.description: Inositol pyrophosphates (PP‐InsPs) are important signaling molecules that regulate diverse cellular processes in eukaryotes, including energy homeostasis, phosphate (Pi) signaling, and phytohormone perception. Yet, in plants, the enzymes responsible for their turnover remain largely unknown. Using a non‐hydrolysable PP‐InsP analog in a pull‐down approach, we identified a family of Arabidopsis NUDIX‐type hydrolases (NUDTs) that group into two closely related subclades.

pmc-12691461.title: Expression and Functional Role of the P2X7 Receptor in Glioma Models and Tissues: A Systematic Review
pmc-12691461.creator: Maciej Baron, Piotr Lewandowski, Bartosz Bula, Kamil Liberka, Andrzej Skrzypiec, Marcin Fyrla, Maciej Czwakiel, Małgorzata Wachowicz, Romuald Wojnicz, Harald Sontheimer, Eiichi Ishikawa
pmc-12691461.description: Simple SummaryGliomas are the most common primary brain tumours, with glioblastoma multiforme (WHO grade IV) representing the most frequent and aggressive subtype. Despite advances in medicine, the prognosis for patients with glioblastoma remains poor, highlighting the urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies.

pmc-12719798.title: A Systems Biology and Drug Repositioning Approach for the Analysis of Mutual Genes Between Celiac Disease and Irritable Bowel Syndrome
pmc-12719798.creator: Haitham Al-Madhagi
pmc-12719798.description: Celiac disease (CD) and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) are two disorders that share common features, such as similar symptoms and autoimmune involvement. However, the molecular genetic mechanisms underlying their pathogenesis remain unclear. An in silico systems biology approach was performed to analyze the RNA‐seq (GSE146190 and GSE166869) and microarray data (GSE164883 and GSE63379) of both diseases.

pmc-12835047.title: Physicochemical characteristics and microbial community analysis of a wetland system treating acid mine drainage
pmc-12835047.creator: Jing Guo, Lei Cheng, Miao Yang, Zhenli Wang
pmc-12835047.description: The elevated heavy metal concentrations and acidic pH conditions characteristic of Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) pose significant environmental challenges, necessitating the development of effective remediation strategies. This study systematically evaluated the performance of a surface-flow constructed wetland system in Ma’anshan, China, for AMD treatment through comprehensive physicochemical characterization and microbial community analysis.

pmc-13162683.title: Understanding Sickle Cell Disease Endothelial Pathology Through the Lens of Liver Sinusoidal Endothelial Cells
pmc-13162683.creator: Tirthadipa Pradhan-Sundd, Brian Branchford, Joan Beckman
pmc-13162683.description: HighlightsWhat are the main findings? Endothelial dysfunction is a hallmark of sickle cell disease (SCD), which is associated with both acute and chronic crises in patients.Whereas lung or kidney endothelial beds are widely studied in SCD, liver sinusoidal endothelial cells are recently gaining attention for their previously unrecognized roles. This review discusses the function and regulation of LSECs in SCD.

pmc-13254324.title: Quantum circuit complexity and unsupervised machine learning of topological order
pmc-13254324.creator: Yanming Che, Clemens Gneiting, Xiaoguang Wang, Franco Nori
pmc-13254324.description: Enabling the discovery of unknown quantum many-body phases of matter remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning for quantum physics. Here, inspired by the close relationship between Kolmogorov complexity and unsupervised machine learning, we explore quantum circuit complexity as a pivot to build intuitive and efficient unsupervised machine learning for topological order in quantum many-body systems.

pmc-13462381.title: Physiological consequences of prolonged static sedentary work among corporate desk employees: a systematic review with implications for the Indian occupational context
pmc-13462381.creator: Mohd Nauman Khan

pmc-13579812.title: Bridging the service gap: health facility challenges in HPV vaccine uptake in rural Uganda
pmc-13579812.creator: Mbonigaba Rukarama Evarist, Ronald Arineitwe Kibonire
pmc-13579812.description: BackgroundCervical cancer remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality among women in Uganda. Although the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine is highly effective in preventing cervical cancer, completion of the recommended two-dose schedule remains low, particularly in rural settings. Rukiga District was selected for this study due to persistently low HPV second-dose (HPV2) completion rates compared with national targets.

pmc-13596099.title: Model predicts coastal paralytic shellfish toxicity in mussels from in situ phytoplankton concentrations
pmc-13596099.creator: Sylvain Gaillard, David K Ralston, V Monica Bricelj, Roman Marin, Bruce Keafer, Dennis J McGillicuddy, Donald M Anderson
pmc-13596099.description: Harmful algal blooms (HABs) of Alexandrium catenella occur annually in the Gulf of Maine, leading to accumulation of paralytic shellfish toxins (PSTs) in bivalve mollusks and closure of harvesting areas. State monitoring programs in the region rely on weekly shellfish sampling and toxin analysis, requiring extensive effort with limited temporal resolution.
